name: platformer-coyote
comment: The wait is 4 ticks because coyoteTime is 0.12s and the loop steps 1/60s, so the window is 7.2 ticks. This waited 8 — longer than the window it was asserting — and so it asserted that a jump taken AFTER coyote time still counts as a coyote jump. It passed only when the player happened to leave the ledge late enough, which is why it failed on a loaded runner and nowhere else. 4 ticks is unambiguously inside the window; raising coyoteTime to fit the scenario would have been the wrong direction.
